stories.title: Powering tax donations with AI powered personalized recommendations
stories.summary: TRUSTBANK partnered with Recursive to build Choice AI using OpenAI models, delivering personalized, conversational recommendations that simplify Furusato Nozei gift discovery. A multi-agent system helps donors navigate thousands of options and find gifts that match their preferences.

stories.title: Introducing Prism
stories.summary: Prism is a free LaTeX-native workspace with GPT-5.2 built in, helping researchers write, collaborate, and reason in one place.

stories.title: UniRG: Scaling medical imaging report generation with multimodal reinforcement learning
stories.summary: AI can help generate medical image reports, but today’s models struggle with varying reporting schemes. Learn how UniRG uses reinforcement learning to boost performance of medical vision-language models. The post UniRG: Scaling medical imaging report generation with multimodal reinforcement learning appeared first on Microsoft Research.
